watch.summary: A streamer playing an egg physics game gets launched into the air by a bounce pad, smashes his egg, and watches in disbelief as his yolk rolls all the way back to the start.

beats.what: Streamer complains about playing a game with no checkpoints.
He hits a target bounce pad and gets launched high into the air.
He crashes down onto the wooden platform and his egg breaks.
His remaining egg yolk rolls all the way down the map into the grass.
Streamer asks in disbelief if everyone is seeing this.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The instant physics mistake sends the player flying and cracking, leading to an extended, funny roll back to the bottom. His understated, calm disbelief adds to the slapstick defeat.
